records.name: Shrine of Our Lady of Good Counsel, Shkodër
records.site_identity_finding: Order of Malta embassy article reports Shkoder Our Lady of Good Counsel shrine raised to minor basilica; title and named shrine supported, precise proposed point remains unchecked.

records.name: Saint Florian Abbey
records.site_identity_finding: Klosterreich operator-facing abbey directory identifies St Florian Abbey in Upper Austria; historic monastery precinct, not a certified point for the abbey church doorway.

records.name: Sanctuary of Absam
records.site_identity_finding: Absam municipal parish page identifies local Catholic church/parish; the formal Marian shrine designation and precise chosen building point need separate operator or diocesan source.

records.name: Marian shrine of Olovo
records.site_identity_finding: Olovo municipal article addresses pilgrimage and Marian shrine in Olovo; source supports locality and devotion but does not certify a particular entrance GPS.

records.name: Basilica of the Holy Blood, Bruges
records.site_identity_finding: Basilica of Holy Blood custodians identify basilica in Burg square Bruges; upper/lower chapels and venerated relic must not become independent duplicated Place pins.

records.name: Basilica of Saint Anthony of Padua, Mugera
records.site_identity_finding: Vatican News documents St Anthony of Padua parish elevation to minor basilica at Mugera, location of the national Marian shrine; distinguish basilica church from grotto feature.

records.name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Copacabana
records.site_identity_finding: Copacabana sanctuary's own historical account supports Marian shrine identity; proposed OSM polygon is a precinct geometry, not independently a church footprint or door.

records.name: Shrine of Our Lady of Socavón, Oruro
records.site_identity_finding: Bolivian episcopal conference reports Oruro Socavon basilica elevation and Marian shrine identity; city-level locality not certified as building GPS.

records.name: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus de Matosinhos, Congonhas
records.site_identity_finding: UNESCO Bom Jesus do Matosinhos listing in Congonhas includes church, stairway, statues and six chapels; distinguish the complex from any single chapel and preserve UNESCO property precision.

records.name: Marian Sanctuary of Baruny
records.site_identity_finding: Academic historical study documents Baruny Marian icon/Basilian Uniate heritage. Modern Catholic ownership, current rite and exact physical church identity are NOT established by this historical article.

records.name: Marian shrine of Trokeli
records.site_identity_finding: Moscow Catholic archdiocese reports pilgrimage to Trokeli Marian sanctuary in Belarus; current site identity supported at village level, direct named Belarusian custodian and point remain pending.

records.name: National Shrine of Saint Kateri Tekakwitha, Kahnawake
records.site_identity_finding: Canadian Saint Kateri shrine operator explicitly locates shrine at Saint Francis Xavier Mission in Kahnawake; saint's tomb and museum are features of this physical complex, not extra sites.

records.name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Bourguillon
records.site_identity_finding: Fribourg Tourism identifies Bourguillon pilgrim chapel with Route de Bourguillon 34 address; contact-office address elsewhere is not the chapel GPS.

records.name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Valère, Sion
records.site_identity_finding: Sion Diocese names Valere basilica on fortified hill and Longeborgne hermitage as two separate locations; place is Valere basilica, not hill centroid or Longeborgne.

records.name: Shrine of Our Lady of the Rosary, La Popa, Cartagena
records.site_identity_finding: Cartagena municipality indexed report identifies Santa Cruz La Popa convent/sanctuary on hill and separate La Candelaria hermitage in Pie de La Popa; municipal server refused direct fetch, so not a direct page review.

records.name: National Shrine of Jesús Nazareno del Rescate, Arroyo Arenas
records.site_identity_finding: Havana Archdiocese parish directory individually lists Jesus Nazareno del Rescate National Shrine at Arroyo Arenas; source is diocesan directory row, not independent coordinate proof.

records.name: National Shrine of Saint Barbara, Havana
records.site_identity_finding: Havana Archdiocese parish directory lists Santa Barbara Parish at Parraga; exact requested National Shrine title is not proved by that row and should not be asserted without separate sanction.

records.name: National Shrine of Saint Lazarus, El Rincón
records.site_identity_finding: Havana Archdiocese parish directory lists Santuario Nacional San Lazaro at Rincon, separately from other Lazarus-named churches; locality pin only.

records.name: Ottobeuren Abbey
records.site_identity_finding: Ottobeuren municipal church and monastery heritage page identifies active abbey/basilica historic complex; a monastery Place must not imply unique basilica door coordinates.

records.name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of Guayco, Bolívar
records.site_identity_finding: Chimbo municipal tourism names Our Lady Nativity del Guayco sanctuary; independent physical place plausible but staged point needs accepted site precision.

records.name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of the Cave of Peace, La Paz
records.site_identity_finding: Original Imantag municipal page timed out; La Paz parish civil government describes Gruta de la Paz sanctuary inside a natural grotto along Apaqui river, not village parish church or convent building.

records.name: Basilica of Our Lady of the Miracles, Ágreda
records.site_identity_finding: Osma-Soria diocesan directory names parish Nuestra Senora de los Milagros in Agreda with Avenida de los Milagros; basilica title and chosen pin need distinct source or inspection.

records.name: Convent of Saint Teresa, Ávila
records.site_identity_finding: Avila tourism confirms church and convent of Saint Teresa built over her birthplace; avoid conflating convent entrance, basilica church, museum and birthplace as extra Place records.

records.name: Abbey of Fontgombault
records.site_identity_finding: Fontgombault Abbey operator identifies Solesmes Benedictine monastery and liturgical use of 1962 books with 1965 changes; no unqualified TLM schedule inferred, abbey site not entrance GPS.

records.name: Our Lady of Tsuwano, Otome Pass
records.site_identity_finding: Original JNTO link describes Tsuwano Catholic parish church in town, NOT the separate Otome Toge martyr chapel at mountain pass; Shimane prefecture's named chapel page confirms distinct Otome Pass site. Replace geometry/source before approval.

records.name: National Shrine of Our Lady of Africa, Subukia
records.site_identity_finding: Kenya Subukia shrine operator lists main church, grotto chapel, spring and Stations route as parts of one pilgrim complex; separate features, not duplicate Place records or precise doorway.

records.name: National Shrine of the Queen of Peace, Ozernoye
records.site_identity_finding: Kazakhstan national tourism identifies Ozernoye Queen of Peace National Shrine inside parish precinct and prints coordinate 53.85161,68.88486; this is an official tourism site point, not independent church entrance.

records.name: Sanctuary of Our Lady of the Rocks, Perast
records.site_identity_finding: Croatian national encyclopedia identifies Baroque Our Lady of the Rocks church on island off Perast Montenegro; locality/island and church should be carefully differentiated.

records.name: Shrine of Our Lady of La Divina Pastora, Siparia
records.site_identity_finding: Siparia Borough history describes La Divina Pastora devotional image and Capuchin mission origins; confirms local devotion but not formal national shrine designation or exact church point.
